subject: [RFC PATCH 35/57] mm/madvise: drop MADV_COLLAPSE's redundant mm reference

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch removes an unnecessary mmgrab() reference in the madvise_collapse() function, which holds a reference to the memory management structure (mm_struct) across its work. The reference was redundant because other parts of the code already hold references to the address space and task's memory, ensuring it remains alive during the operation.
